name: Frenzied Gorespawn and Death Kiss — goad a target that player controls, goad up to X targets
notes: Found by the audit (2026-11-17), once it read "goad / suspect target …" as the Goaded / Suspected trait. Frenzied Gorespawn: "When this creature enters, for each opponent, goad target creature that player controls." Fired as one ability, "that player" was read as no one in particular and the picker listed your own creatures; it now fires once an opponent (the Nihiloor split, _forEachOpponentReflexiveText), each picking among that opponent's creatures (a saved board keeps the split text, so only --build exercises the split itself). Death Kiss: "When this creature becomes monstrous, goad up to X target creatures your opponents control." The goad verb parser set no maxTargets, so the picker took one creature; with X = 2 it now takes two.

scryfallData.name: Frenzied Gorespawn
scryfallData.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, for each opponent, goad target creature that player controls. (Until your next turn, those creatures attack each combat if able and attack a player other than you if able.)
Whenever one or more creatures attack one of your opponents, those creatures gain menace until end of turn.

scryfallData.name: Death Kiss
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Whenever a creature an opponent controls attacks one of your opponents, double its power until end of turn.
{X}{X}{R}: Monstrosity X. (If this creature isn't monstrous, put X +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes monstrous.)
When this creature becomes monstrous, goad up to X target creatures your opponents control.
